# sauth_client (Resource)

The client records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) app id
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String) name

### Optional

- `description` (String) description
- `expires_at` (String) expires at
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) the client secret; minted when left out on create, never exported
- `status` (String) client status
